mapper.select: SELECT ITEM_ID AS itemId, TARGET_TYPE AS targetType, CATEGORY AS category, ITEM_TITLE AS itemTitle, QUESTION AS question, SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder, IS_USE AS isUse, REG_DATE AS regDate FROM CHECKLIST_ITEM WHERE TARGET_TYPE = #{targetType} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, ITEM_ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHECKLIST_ITEM ( ITEM_ID, TARGET_TYPE, CATEGORY, ITEM_TITLE, QUESTION, SORT_ORDER, IS_USE, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_CHECKLIST_ITEM_ID.NEXTVAL, #{targetType}, #{category}, #{itemTitle}, #{question}, #{sortOrder}, #{isUse}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE CHECKLIST_ITEM SET CATEGORY = #{category}, ITEM_TITLE = #{itemTitle}, QUESTION = #{question}, SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder}, IS_USE = #{isUse} WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
mapper.select: SELECT R.USER_ID AS userId, MIN(I.TARGET_TYPE) AS targetType, MAX(R.CHECK_DATE) AS checkDate, TO_CHAR(MAX(R.CHECK_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS checkDateStr, COUNT(R.RESULT_ID) AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN R.CHECK_STATUS = '정상' THEN 1 END) AS normalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN R.CHECK_STATUS = '주의' THEN 1 END) AS cautionCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN R.CHECK_STATUS = '위험' THEN 1 END) AS dangerCount FROM CHECKLIST_RESULT R JOIN CHECKLIST_ITEM I ON R.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID GROUP BY R.USER_ID, TO_CHAR(R.CHECK_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY MAX(R.CHECK_DATE) DESC

SELECT R.RESULT_ID AS resultId, R.USER_ID AS userId, I.TARGET_TYPE AS targetType, I.CATEGORY AS category, I.ITEM_TITLE AS itemTitle, I.QUESTION AS question, R.CHECK_STATUS AS checkStatus, R.REMARK AS remark, TO_CHAR(R.CHECK_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS checkDateStr FROM CHECKLIST_RESULT R JOIN CHECKLIST_ITEM I ON R.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND TO_CHAR(R.CHECK_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') = #{checkDateStr} ORDER BY I.SORT_ORDER ASC, I.ITEM_ID ASC
